about.intro_content: Prof. Ying-Bo Chen is a Professor in the Department of Gastric Surgery at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center (SYSUCC), Guangzhou, specialising in gastric and abdominal surgical oncology.
about.detailed_content: Prof. Chen is a co-investigator on landmark clinical trials in gastric cancer, including a randomised phase 2 trial of perioperative toripalimab plus chemotherapy in locally advanced gastric or gastro-esophageal junction cancer, published in Nature Medicine. He has also senior-authored research on Helicobacter pylori eradication after radical gastrectomy, published in JAMA Network Open, and contributed to research on circulating tumour DNA for predicting gastric cancer recurrence after adjuvant chemotherapy.

faq.section_heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Prof. Ying-Bo Chen

items.question: Does Prof. Ying-Bo Chen accept international patients?
items.answer: CancerFax can coordinate medical report review and consultation support for international patients seeking an opinion related to gastric cancer at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center, subject to hospital availability and case acceptance.

items.question: What is Prof. Chen's area of specialisation?
items.answer: Prof. Chen specialises in gastric and abdominal surgical oncology, with active involvement in perioperative immunotherapy trials and post-surgical care research.

items.question: How can I request a consultation or second opinion?
items.answer: Submit your medical reports through CancerFax. The CancerFax team reviews the documents, prepares the case for submission, and coordinates next steps with SYSUCC's International Medical Center, subject to availability.

items.question: Is Prof. Chen involved in clinical trials for gastric cancer?
items.answer: Yes. Prof. Chen was a co-investigator on a randomised phase 2 trial of perioperative toripalimab plus chemotherapy for locally advanced gastric cancer, published in Nature Medicine in 2024.

items.question: What follow-up care does Prof. Chen's team provide after gastrectomy?
items.answer: Prof. Chen's research has examined post-gastrectomy care measures, including Helicobacter pylori eradication and circulating tumour DNA-based recurrence monitoring, to support long-term outcomes after surgery.
